events.title: lowbrain (Perth)
events.description: Boorloo / Perth-based producer Lowbrain is the West Coast of Aus’s biggest up and comer in dance music and is already making his mark on the local and international dance scenes. Debuting in 2024 on Perth label Lab Six Records, Lowbrain is now working closely with the team at Love Clvb / Sweat It Out and working on some sneaky bits with Luude’s No Instruction label. Lowbrain has received strong support from the local music scene in Perth, having headlined shows at the Vault and for Tina Says’ Body Control as well as having supported the likes of Bella Claxton, LO’99, Tina Says and Solsta. Lowbrain effortlessly blends hip-hop-influenced heaters with bumpy classic flows, or four on the floor bangers with two-step slammers, displaying huge versatility and always leaving you wondering what he’s going to do next. Despite hailing from the most isolated capital city in the world, Lowbrain’s reach is undeniable with his tracks already making waves on the global club circuit with support on his ID catalogue including Interplanetary Criminal, Club Angel, Bushbaby, Benwal, Badger, Its Murph, Morgan Seatree, and many more. Lowbrain has also received consistent industry recognition amounting several BBC Radio 1 spins, A George FM Drive spotlight and Mahi Mix takeover, multiple simultaneous Spotify + Apple Music editorial placements and plenty of chatter on various Triple J specialty programs. Kicking off 2026 and with a focus on his unreleased club-heavers, Lowbrain is touching down with a USB full of IDs and live set exclusives, featuring a ton of collabs with both local and international heavyweights. #block-5df3c5a122ab703bfd16 { --stroke-style: none;--stroke-thickness: 6px; } #block-5df3c5a122ab703bfd16 .sqs-html-content { --tweak-text-block-padding: 6% 6% 6% 6%; --tweak-text-block-padding: initial; } #block-5df3c5a122ab703bfd16 { mix-blend-mode: var(--tweak-text-block-blend ); border-radius: var(--tweak-text-block-radius); } #block-5df3c5a122ab703bfd16 { --tweak-text-block-radius: 0px 0px 0px 0px; } #block-5df3c5a122ab703bfd16 { } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-5df3c5a122ab703bfd16 { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-5df3c5a122ab703bfd16 .sqs-html-content { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { } tickets #block-4feaea89706c8e04f3bd { --sqs-block-content-flex: 0; } #block-4feaea89706c8e04f3bd { --opacity: 100%; --translate-x: 0px; --translate-y: 0px; --rotation: 0deg; --scale-x: 100%; --scale-y: 100%; --skew-x: 0deg; --skew-y: 0deg; --origin-x: 50%; --origin-y: 50%; --block-transform: none; opacity: var(--opacity, 1); transform: var(--block-transform); transform-origin: var(--origin-x) var(--origin-y); }

The goal with second space is creating a space where the younger group of people can create new communities, connect with their friends, enjoy great music, and make new friends. The event features high valued and high quality DJs, immersive visuals and a planned out function where young teenagers can experience a real nightclub while staying appropriate for the younger audience.  SecondSpace is all about maintaining a welcoming environment with everyone who attends, all aspects of the event is designed to make all guests feel comfortable, excited, and entertained. It is designed to supply people a memorable night and to be separated from any other party with its iconic venue and large capacity. In the making of Second Space, the aim was to build something that gives young teenagers an alternative social space before they turn 18. More then just a club party, the event is aimed to bring young teenagers together and provide their first proper experience with nightlife in clubs, the atmosphere is built to keep them wanting to come back for the next event.
